perspective:
From Keith Ndiaye’s perspective:

- He works as a construction worker at a construction company; Elizabeth Sun is the receptionist there. They have a friendly but professional colleague relationship, mainly through his office visits for paperwork and project updates.
- Over the past few days, Keith observed Elizabeth being unusually curt/short with him.
- He wondered whether he had upset her, possibly through a misunderstanding or an unknown mistake.
- He asked Elizabeth if he had done something to upset her. She told him no, not at all; she was dealing with personal stuff and apologized if she seemed short.
- Keith felt sympathetic after learning her shortness was not anger toward him but personal stress.
- He offered support: told her he understood she was going through a tough time, said he was available if she needed someone to talk to, and suggested a coffee break.
- Elizabeth accepted, saying that was kind, coffee sounded good, and thanked him.
- During the coffee break, Elizabeth shared more about her stresses. Keith perceived them as quite severe, based on what she told him.
- Keith thought professional help might benefit her, but worried about offending her.
- He told Elizabeth he appreciated her sharing, asked if she had considered talking to a professional, and said an external perspective can sometimes help.
- Elizabeth told him she had thought about it but was unsure; she was hesitant about seeking help.
- Afterward, Keith observed Elizabeth become slightly withdrawn. He suspected his suggestion might have embarrassed her and felt regretful.
- He told her he hoped he had not overstepped and that he wanted her to know he was there to support her no matter what.
- Elizabeth told him he did not overstep, she appreciated his concern, and it was just a lot to think about.
- After their last conversation, Keith observed Elizabeth seeming more open and appreciative. He believed she valued his support and felt more comfortable around him.
- He intended to maintain this supportive relationship.
- He told her he was glad they could talk and that he is always there if she needs to chat or take a break together.
- Elizabeth thanked him, said it meant a lot, and that she felt better knowing she had his support.

Keith has access only to what he observed, what Elizabeth told him, his own actions, and his own thoughts/suspicions about the situation.
